non_blocking_findings.finding: No live Neo4j connection, schema application, write/read, reconciliation or production latency run was authorized or performed. Approval covers the offline temporal Graph/Hybrid contract established by normalized parameters, exact Cypher shape, deterministic fixtures and mocks; it does not claim live database correctness or performance.

resolved_findings.detail: The writer normalizes published_at, retrieved_at, filed_at, effective_from, effective_to and materialized_at to timezone-aware UTC before any V2 write. EvidenceObservationV2 ON CREATE uses an exact null-safe CASE WHEN parameter IS NULL THEN null ELSE datetime(parameter) END conversion for every temporal property, compatible with traversal comparisons against datetime($as_of). Invalid required values fail closed and no current-time fallback exists.

Legacy aggregate MERGE is reachable only when write_mode=legacy and provenance=legacy_explicit. Quarantined, V2-origin, unknown-provenance, incomplete-identity, missing-time, invalid-time and reversed-interval documents are rejected before entity or relation execution with zero writes and stable sanitized rejection codes/counts.

Canonical Stage 03 materialized_at, with the accepted ingested_at provenance alias, is required for temporal V2, normalized, persisted as a Neo4j DateTime on EvidenceObservationV2 ON CREATE, and not overwritten on a deterministic retry of the same evidence identity.

Vector, Graph, RRF and Hybrid trace/lifecycle identity now reports stage 04A, revision 1, attempt 2, agent data_rag. Sentinel coverage proves the existing compact allowlist excludes raw query, evidence text, URLs, headers, secrets and exception strings. OBS-04A-001 through OBS-04A-003 remain preserved.

evidence.detail: Control revision 77 is ACTIVE/REVIEW for Stage 04A revision 1 attempt 2 with reviewer as the only support agent. The matching draft-ready, required observability, PRIMARY_FINAL implementation and QA artifacts exist at their recorded hashes. Observability is AUDITED with OBS-04A-004 accepted and applied; QA status is PASS.

Attempt 1 review remains immutable and REJECTED with exactly three blockers. Attempt 2 explicitly supersedes the prior draft/QA/review chain as applicable; all six Attempt 1 artifact hashes match the immutable values independently checked by Observability and QA.

All Stage 04A product, test, fixture and current-attempt artifact paths have exact locks for their writers, and the control validator reports CONTROL VALID for draft-ready, observability, implementation and QA. No ownership or scope violation was established. Stage 04B remains PENDING/NOT_STARTED at revision 0 attempt 0.

The accepted V2 write boundary persists like-typed Neo4j DateTime properties and rejects unknown/invalid required time without mapping it to now. Context-bound traversal applies quarantine, ticker, dataset version, publication, retrieval, filing and effective-interval predicates before entity traversal and ranking, and temporal Graph errors never fall back to legacy traversal.

Graph extraction reuses the accepted Stage 03 document_id, chunk_id and evidence_id. Temporal entity and relation-observation identities are deterministic; document, chunk, evidence and relation observations use immutable MERGE keys. materialized_at is create-only and unchanged on identical retry.

Vector and Graph consume the same validated ForecastContext before ranking/traversal. Shared document/chunk/evidence identities and Vector/Graph citation origins survive fusion. RRF ordering and hybrid, vector_only, graph_only and unavailable degradation modes are deterministic.

OBS-04A-001 through OBS-04A-004 are preserved or resolved. Trace processors and lifecycle telemetry retain only compact stage/context/version identity, bounded counts, latency, degradation and stable codes. No chain-of-thought, brain_reasoning, raw chunk/evidence, full filing, URL, credential, header, secret or original exception text is persisted by Stage 04A instrumentation.

Reviewer independently ran 27 Attempt 2 blocker counterexamples, 17 frozen Database V2/Neo4j contract tests and the 93-test focused Graph/Hybrid suite; all passed with zero failures. QA additionally reports 349 RAG/Stage03 regressions and 1293 collected tests with zero collection errors.

Rollback is documented as source restoration; no database rollback is required because no external operation occurred. No live Neo4j access, migration, external read/write, reconciliation, seed/backfill, legacy deletion, route switch, deploy, commit or push was performed.

Stage 04A does not modify DCF/WACC, the nine financial intents/mappers, deterministic Quant outputs, forecast target/provider/universe/action policy, backtesting, Manager lifecycle, analysis prompts or forecast storage keys. Accepted upstream contracts remain unchanged.
